function.description: Mark ONE position of this agent's own book: size, cost, value, unrealized % and distance from the high (on a spend-grade price only), hours open, and whether its exit barriers (from the trading mandate's preset) are near or crossed. Built for an exit job's $0 precheck. Reveals own funds — owner-only.
function.name: defi_data_position_mark

account.description: The holder of the book row: '' = the treasury wallet, else the token-bound account address

address.description: The token contract / mint address of the book row

chain.description: The chain of the book row (base, robinhood, solana, …)

mandate.description: The trading mandate id whose exit preset sets the barriers. A scheduled job's own payload.mandate wins.
